fields.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.

It does not mention sale/licensing/provision, nonpublic competitor data details, the exclusions, attorney's fees, the burden of proof, or City code enforcement.
